topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and sanctions procedure (POL-05 4.12); annual acknowledgment
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (97%); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk and CMMC readiness reports from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Security organization, roles, and reporting lines defined in POL-01 section 3 and the SSP
Hiring screens, role descriptions, and training for security staff and platform administrators
gap: No role-based training for ERP and portal administrators (POAM-006)

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and POA&M; performance objectives for owners
Inventory, logging, and data flow information support controls
evidence: Asset inventory; SIEM source list; P04 diagram
gap: Inventory missing 64 components; ERP, WMS, and portal logs not centralized (POAM-007, POAM-010)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; security responsibilities in onboarding
Platform commitments communicated to resellers through portal terms and the security page
evidence: Portal terms; security page; reseller agreements
gap: No written system description or customer responsibility list for resellers (for example, reseller administrators managing their own users)
remediation: Publish the system description and complementary user entity controls for resellers

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk objectives and appetite approved (P01)
Annual risk assessment covering the platform, vendors, and fraud (P01)
Fraud risk considered: portal account takeover, payment diversion, fraudulent orders
evidence: P01 R-010, R-011; credit review procedure
gap: Ship-to change alerts and portal fraud monitoring not in place (R-011)

control_description: Significant changes (new resellers on the API, portal releases, vendor changes) assessed
gap: Vendor-released portal changes are not assessed by the company
remediation: Review vendor release notes at the change board

control_description: Ongoing monitoring and annual independent assessment (P07)
evidence: P07 plan and results; MSSP reports

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported monthly and quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk assessment and the SSP baseline
Technology general controls: access, change, operations, configuration
gap: Configuration standards missing for network devices and SaaS tenants (POAM-009)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Controls deployed through POL-01 to POL-05 and standards
gap: Policies effective only from 2026-10-01; 6 standards in draft
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA for workforce; role-based access; reseller authentication on the portal
gap: Reseller MFA optional (38% of accounts); credential stuffing in 2026-04 (POAM-026)

control_description: Access requests approved by system owners; reseller administrators approve their users
evidence: Access tickets; portal user approval workflow

control_description: Least privilege and periodic reviews
gap: 14 ERP administrators with standing rights; transfers keep roles; annual WMS reviews (POAM-002, POAM-003)
remediation: Reduce administrators; quarterly reviews; access broker

control_description: Physical access to DCs and offices; provider data centers inherited
gap: DC-2 badges not reconciled (POAM-017)

control_description: Media sanitization with certificates; data deletion at vendor exit

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls, API gateway, vendor edge protection
evidence: Firewall rules; gateway configuration; vendor SOC 2
gap: OT reachable from corporate networks (POAM-005); integrator remote tool (POAM-004)
remediation: OT segmentation and remote access gateway

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for portal, API, and EDI; DLP in the enclave
evidence: TLS scans; API gateway mutual TLS

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints and servers; application allowlisting in the enclave

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and configuration monitoring
gap: Missed remediation targets; no drift monitoring for SaaS and network devices (POAM-018, POAM-009)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors security events 24x7
gap: ERP, portal, and integration services logs not monitored (POAM-007)
remediation: Onboard portal, ERP, and API logs with use cases

control_description: Events triaged and evaluated by the MSSP and the Security Manager
Incident response plan and P08 runbooks
gap: Runbooks new; tabletops not yet held; lessons from 2026-04 not incorporated (POAM-015)

control_description: Recovery from incidents per the contingency plan
gap: Integration services never restore-tested; WMS rebuild slower than RTO (POAM-011)

control_description: Change advisory board approves platform changes; integration code reviewed
evidence: Change tickets (25 sampled in P07 for the enclave; platform sample due)
gap: Integration service changes lack a documented second review
remediation: Second reviewer for integration code and pricing-rule changes

control_description: Business disruption risks in the BIA and contingency plan
gap: TMS and ERP outage workarounds not in the plan

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor tiering and annual SOC 2 reviews (Part B)
gap: 9 of 22 Tier 1 reviews overdue; portal vendor RPO meets the BIA but its report has a change-management exception (POAM-019)
remediation: Complete overdue reviews; contract notice terms

control_description: Capacity monitoring of the portal (vendor) and integration services
evidence: Vendor capacity reports; API gateway metrics

control_description: Backups, vendor resilience, and environmental protections
gap: ERP vendor RTO of 24 hours does not meet the 6-hour BIA need (R-014)
remediation: Recovery terms at the 2027 ERP renewal; queue-and-replay workaround documented

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: Integration services and portal sync recovery never tested (POAM-011)
remediation: Quarterly restore tests including the order queue replay

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Contract pricing and reseller data classified Confidential (POL-04) and restricted by role
gap: Data warehouse bulk extracts not alerted (R-047); chatbot cross-account test pending (R-029)

control_description: Confidential data disposed of under retention rules
gap: No retention schedule for reseller order history in the integration services

control_description: Processing objectives defined: order accuracy, pricing accuracy, ship notice timeliness
gap: Objectives defined but not documented in the system description
remediation: Document objectives in the system description

control_description: Input controls: API schema validation, pricing rules, credit checks
evidence: API gateway validation rules; ERP edit checks

control_description: Processing controls: ERP-portal sync reconciliation and exception queue
gap: Sync exceptions reviewed ad hoc, not daily; 2 unexplained exceptions in July

control_description: Output controls: order confirmations, ship notices, invoices
gap: No reconciliation of ship notices sent versus shipments

control_description: Stored order data protected and complete
